assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaire does not contain any questions asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for other household members while performing other activities or without care being their main activity. The only references to care responsibilities in the questionnaire appear as reasons for not seeking work (Section J, j7), not being available to work (Section J, j12), quitting a job (Section J, j24), or not working more hours (Section H, h16), which do not satisfy the indicator requirement.
